title: Laughing Dog
blurb: The laughing dog — a dog that has learned mockery. This wheezy canine cackle became the internet's designated point-and-laugh sound: it plays at fails, bad takes, and hubris meeting consequences. Being laughed at by a dog is somehow more humbling than being laughed at by people, which is exactly why the meme works. Nelson Muntz energy, golden retriever body.
origin: A viral clip of a dog appearing to laugh, used to mock fails.
